optimizedCVData.summary: Physics teacher with 8 years of experience explaining complex concepts to diverse audiences and managing relationships with students, parents, and senior stakeholders at scale. Skilled at designing structured learning programmes, delivering one-to-one and group training, and using data to track progress and communicate outcomes clearly. Motivated to transition into a customer success role where clear communication, stakeholder management, and a genuine interest in helping people get value from a product are the core of the job. Currently building technical skills through self-directed Python study and the Google Data Analytics Certificate.

experience.position: Teacher of Physics and Head of Year 9
bullets: Teach physics to 140 students a year across Years 9 to 13, translating abstract scientific concepts into accessible, structured learning for a wide range of learners.

Raised the share of Year 11 students achieving grade 5 or above from 71% to 86% over three years by identifying at-risk students early, adjusting teaching approaches, and maintaining consistent communication with parents.
Designed the department's Year 9 practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to deliver it, acting as an internal subject-matter expert and onboarding resource for the team.
Manage relationships across a year group of 210 students, running weekly parent calls and two parents' evenings per term to communicate progress, address concerns, and maintain trust with families.
Taught KS3 and KS4 science across multiple year groups, adapting delivery style and content to meet varied student needs and learning levels.
Coached the school robotics club, introducing students to practical problem-solving and technology concepts in an extracurricular setting.
Tracked student progress and contributed to department reporting, developing habits of data-informed decision-making applied consistently throughout teaching career.
Mentor children aged 9 to 12 on Scratch and introductory Python in evening sessions, developing patience and adaptability when teaching technical concepts to beginners.
Applies self-directed learning in Python to mentoring practice, reinforcing both personal technical development and the ability to guide others through early-stage skill building.
Demonstrates sustained commitment to the technology sector outside of formal employment, complementing ongoing study toward the Google Data Analytics Certificate.

analysis.summary: Daniel is a career-changer from secondary education to customer success, so the strategy was to reframe his 8 years of teaching as directly transferable customer-facing experience: explaining complex concepts, managing stakeholder relationships, tracking progress data, and delivering structured onboarding and training. Given the significant number of verified missing skills (particularly SaaS, contract negotiation, and formal CS methodology experience), the CV focuses on honest, compelling repositioning of his genuine strengths rather than overstating fit.
key_changes: Reframed the headline and summary to speak directly to customer success hiring managers, positioning teaching as structured onboarding, training delivery, and stakeholder communication rather than classroom instruction.

Repositioned the Head of Year role to emphasise relationship management at scale (210-student year group, weekly parent calls, termly senior leadership presentations) as analogous to managing a customer portfolio.
Highlighted curriculum design and colleague training as evidence of onboarding programme development and adult learning facilitation, which are directly relevant to a CSM role.
Brought the volunteer coding mentorship forward to signal genuine interest in the technology sector and self-directed learning (Python, Google Data Analytics Certificate in progress).
Preserved all verified metrics exactly as sourced (8 years, 140 students, 71% to 86% grade improvement, 12 colleagues trained, 210-student year group) without fabricating any additional numbers.
Kept ATS compatibility honest at a moderate score reflecting the genuine gap in SaaS and formal CS methodology experience, rather than inflating it with skills Daniel does not possess.

coverLetter:
Daniel Okafor
Leeds, UK
daniel.okafor@example.org
+44 20 5550 0188

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

Raising student attainment from 71% to 86% over three years required the same core skill Datadog's Customer Success team depends on: identifying where someone is struggling, explaining complex information in a way that clicks, and staying with them until the outcome improves.

For eight years I have managed relationships across a community of over 140 students, parents, and colleagues annually, translating technical content into clear, actionable guidance through one-to-one coaching, workshop facilitation, and regular stakeholder calls. The work demanded close attention to detail, proactive monitoring of progress data, and cross-functional collaboration with senior leadership, pastoral staff, and external partners. These are the same instincts your role asks for: building mutual trust with customers, identifying usage trends before they become risks, and advocating for the people you serve internally. I track progress in Excel and Google Sheets, and I am developing my analytical skills further through a Google Data Analytics Certificate currently in progress.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my background in relationship management and structured communication translates to the Customer Success Manager role at Datadog. I am available for a conversation at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Customer Success Manager, Daniel Okafor
applicationEmail.body:
Hi there,

Explaining complex ideas clearly and building trust with people over time is what I have done across 8 years of teaching, and I am now looking to bring those skills directly into a customer-facing role at Datadog. Managing a year group of 210 students and their families has meant running regular one-to-one calls, tracking progress data in spreadsheets, and presenting findings to senior stakeholders, all of which maps closely to the relationship management and account monitoring work your team does. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I would welcome a call any weekday between 4pm and 7pm UK time to discuss how my background fits what you are building.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor
